name: Moses
hook: The lawgiver of Exodus: burning bush, plagues, Sinai and the Promised Land.

facts.label: Exodus
facts.statement: In Exodus, Moses hears God from the burning bush and tells Pharaoh, "Let my people go," then leads Israel out of Egypt.

facts.label: Mount Sinai
facts.statement: Moses receives the Ten Commandments on Mount Sinai; the two stone tablets are kept in the Ark of the Covenant.

facts.label: Aaron
facts.statement: Aaron, Moses' brother, makes the golden calf from the Israelites' jewelry while Moses is on Sinai.

facts.label: Deuteronomy
facts.statement: Deuteronomy, the fifth book of the Old Testament, is Moses' farewell address and contains his farewell song.

facts.label: The Ten Commandments
facts.statement: Cecil B. DeMille's The Ten Commandments premiered in 1923 and was remade in 1956 with Charlton Heston as Moses.

facts.label: Miriam
facts.statement: Miriam, Moses' sister, leads the women in song and dance after the crossing of the Red Sea.

facts.label: Harriet Tubman
facts.statement: Harriet Tubman was called "Moses" for leading enslaved people out of the South, as in the spiritual "Go Down, Moses."
